nfigCommon. A PUSCH occasion for a PUSCH transmission is defined by a time resource and a frequency resource and is associated with a DM-RS provided by cg-DMRS-Configuration for the configuration of PUSCH transmissions. A UE can be provided a number of repetitions for a PUSCH transmission by repK or numberOfRepetitions. If the number of repetitions is provided and larger than 1, all the PUSCH occasions of the repetitions for the PUSCH transmission are mapped to the same SS/PBCH block index(es). For the initial transmission or autonomous retransmission of an initial transport block provided for PUSCH transmission in RACH-less handover, the UE encodes the transport block using redundancy version number 0 if the UE is not provided repK-RV. [1] R1-2501234 Correction on RACH-less handover for NTN ASUSTeK

R1-2501234 Correction on RACH-less handover for NTN ASUSTeK Decision: Comeback on Tuesday, to be moderated by Denny (ASUSTeK) R1-2501507 Summary of RACH-less HO for NTN Moderator (ASUSTeK) From Wednesday session Agreement The TP in section 4 of R1-2501507 is endorsed. Final CR in: R1-2501596 Correction on RACH-less handover for NTN Moderator(ASUSTeK), Huawei, Hisilicon (Rel-18, 38.213, NR_NTN_enh-Core, CR0696, Cat F) is agreed. R1-2500336 Discussion on E-UTRAN measurement in IoT-NTN vivo R1-2500511 Discussion on E-UTRAN measurement in IoT NTN Nokia, Nokia Shanghai Bell R1-2501421 Summary of discussion on E-UTRAN measurement in IoT NTN Moderator (vivo) Presented in Monday session. R1-2501486 Summary#2 of discussion on E-UTRAN measurement in IoT NTN Moderator (vivo) From Tuesday session Agreement Send an LS to ask RAN4 the following: Whether any of the following measurement quantities, described in clause 5.2 of TS 36.214, are applicable for NB-IoT-based NTN and/or eMTC-based NTN: DL RS TX power Received Interference Power Thermal Noise Power For the measurement quantitie(s) that are applicable, if any, whether reference point(s) need to be defined. Comeback for draft LS on Wednesday. R1-2501511 Draft LS on measurement quantities for IoT NTN Moderator (vivo) Decision: The draft LS is endorsed. Final LS is approved in R1-2501512. From AI5 R1-2500006 LS on soft satellite switch with re-sync RAN2, Huawei Decision: RAN2 is requesting RAN1 input on possible introduction of a temporarily shifted SSB pattern during [t-ServiceStart, t-Service] for soft satellite switching with re-sync. RAN1 response is necessary - Xiaolei (Huawei). R1-2501505 Summary of discussion on the LS reply of soft-satellite switching with re-sync Moderator (Huawei) Presented in Tuesday session. R1-2501541 Summary#2 of discussion on the LS reply of soft-satellite switching with re-sync Moderator (Huawei) From Wednesday session Agreement The following RAN1 reply to RAN2 is endorsed. RAN1 would like to ask RAN2 for further clarification on the question and assumptions below: Is RAN2 asking whether a Rel-18 UE (based on current Rel-18 RAN1 specifications) can maintain the pre-acquired DL synchronization started between [t-ServiceStart, t-Service] with target satellite if the SSB pattern (e.g., SSB offset) is changed (determined by ssb-TimeOffset) at t-Service, or whether RAN2 assumes that some RAN1 specification work may be needed? RAN1 assumes that the meaning of “the SSB pattern is changed” is that only the time offset is changed (may be determined by ssb-TimeOffset). RAN1 assumes that the SIB19 of the source satellite includes ephemeris information of the target satellite, and that such information will not get outdated by the time the satellite switch occurs. R1-2501506 Draft reply LS on soft satellite switch with re-sync Moderator (Huawei) Decision: The draft LS is endorsed. Final LS is approved in R1-2501606.
